spanish: Habla a hijos de Israel, y dirás a ellos: Cuando ustedes pasen el Yarden a tierra de Canaán,

findings.issue: כִּי is only a conjunction, so "Cuando" selects the temporal sense; the qal active participle is smoothed to the finite subjunctive "pasen".

notes: 2ms imperative and weqatal stay distinct from 2mp אַתֶּם; DOM את is untranslated; Israel and Canaán match the locked names.
